import pandas as pd

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Get indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness for each indicator
kept_indicators = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    kept_indicators.append((col, missing_count, missing_rate, kept))

# Create missingness report DataFrame
report_data = [
    {'indicator': col, 'missing_count': mc, 'missing_rate': mr, 'kept': kept}
    for col, mc, mr, kept in kept_indicators
]
report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_data)
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select only indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + [col for col, _, _, kept in kept_indicators if kept]
selected_df = df[selected_cols]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
